summary: Controlled field to submit a coupon code and display an external status.
whenToUse: Collect a discount code in an app-managed checkout.
whenNotToUse: Validating or applying coupons on the client: delegate the logic to the caller.

props.name: label / applyLabel
props.description: Visible labels for the field and the action.

props.name: message
props.description: Optional message associated with the status.

keyboard.action: Edits the code and submits the form.

accessibility: Errors and states are announced in a live region.
responsive: The button moves below the field on narrow viewports.
customization: Composed with TextField and Button; CSS with --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: Expecting the component to validate or apply the coupon.
